items.prompt: What does the writer suggest about the excavation of the Collegium Augustalium?

options.text: Digging there began only after the glassy material was noticed
More than one body was recovered from the building
The building had probably been in use as a private home
The remains found there were excavated fairly recently

items.evidence: Among the victims uncovered during excavations of the Collegium Augustalium, a public building in the town centre, was a young man of around 20 years old, found lying face down on a wooden bed where he had apparently been sleeping when the flows arrived.

distractor_analysis.A: Ters sira -- B/2 kalintilarin arkeologlarca 1960'lardan beri bilindigini, camsi maddenin ise cok daha sonraki bir incelemede fark edildigini soyluyor; secenek iki olayin sirasini tersine ceviriyor.
distractor_analysis.C: Yer degistirme -- Collegium Augustalium B/1'de kent merkezinde bir KAMU binasi olarak tanitiliyor; ozel konut oldugu hicbir yerde soylenmiyor.
distractor_analysis.D: Kapsam kaydirma -- yakin tarihli olan sey kazi degil inceleme; kalintilar B/2'ye gore altmis yildir biliniyor.

items.explanation: Paragraph B introduces the young man as one 'among the victims uncovered during excavations' of the Collegium Augustalium, which implies that other bodies were found there as well.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Why does the writer mention timber roof beams, food and fabric?
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: These flows swept through the streets and buildings so quickly that many residents were killed almost instantly, and over the following days the town was sealed beneath roughly 20 metres of volcanic deposits, a burial so complete that timber roof beams, food, and even fabric survived for centuries in a way rarely seen at other Roman sites.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Sorunun ekseni arkeoloji genel bilgisi: Herculaneum'un organik malzemeyi -- ahsap, yiyecek, kumas -- olaganustu iyi korumasiyla taninmasi yaygin bir bilgi. Sayilan nesnelerin neden anildigi bu bilgiyle dogrudan biliniyor; secenek dengelemesi bunu kapatmaz.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Yuva bosaltilip ayni pasajdan yeni bir soruyla dolduruldu. Eski soru A/3'e dayaniyordu: ahsap kirislerin, yiyecegin ve kumasin neden anildigi. Herculaneum'un organik malzemeyi olaganustu iyi korumasi arkeolojinin en cok anlatilan olgularindan biri oldugu icin 'kirilgan seyler alisilmadik bicimde dayandi' cevabi pasajsiz da cikiyordu. Yeni soru A paragrafina hic degmiyor: kanit B/1'e tasindi ve cevap tek bir sozcugun tasidigi cikarima baglandi ('Among the victims uncovered' -> binada baska kurbanlar da vardi). Bu, vaka hakkinda okunmus her seyin disinda kalan bir metin ayrintisi; en cok anlatilan ayrintilar (yatak, uyku, yas) bilerek soru ekseni yapilmadi. Uc celdirici de metnin verdigi sirayi ya da tanimi tersine ceviriyor. Kip dengesi icin iki celdirici olculu yazildi ('probably', 'fairly recently').

items.prompt: What does the writer say about the 20 metres of volcanic material that covered the town?

options.text: It was laid down within minutes of the first flow reaching the town
It consisted mainly of ash that had fallen from the air
It protected stone buildings but destroyed everything made of wood
It built up over the days that followed the eruption

items.evidence: These flows swept through the streets and buildings so quickly that many residents were killed almost instantly, and over the following days the town was sealed beneath roughly 20 metres of volcanic deposits, a burial so complete that timber roof beams, food, and even fabric survived for centuries in a way rarely seen at other Roman sites.

distractor_analysis.A: Hiz kaydirma -- A/3 akintilarin sokaklari 'cok cabuk' supurdugunu soyluyor, ama 20 metrelik ortu icin verdigi sure bu degil: gomulme 'izleyen gunler boyunca' tamamlaniyor. Sezgi burada calisir, cunku felaketin hepsinin birkac dakikada bittigi yaygin bir varsayimdir.
distractor_analysis.B: Yer degistirme -- A/1 patlamanin kentleri 'yalnizca kulle gomdugu' anlatisinin komsu Pompeii'ye ait yaygin bir anlati oldugunu soyleyip bu kasaba icin reddediyor; A/2 kasabayi supuren seyin bir dizi piroklastik akinti oldugunu belirtiyor. Genel kultur bu secenege gidiyor ve yaniliyor.
distractor_analysis.C: Ters yon -- ayni cumle gomulmenin oylesine eksiksiz oldugunu, ahsap cati kirislerinin, yiyecegin ve hatta kumasin yuzyillar boyu dayandigini soyluyor; ahsabin yok oldugu iddiasi metnin tersi.

items.explanation: Paragraph A says that over the following days the town was sealed beneath roughly 20 metres of volcanic deposits.

revision.onceki_prompt: What did the team's purpose-built image-processing method make possible?

onceki_secenekler.B: Confirming every sheath layer had survived
onceki_secenekler.C: Telling real nerve structures from stray fragments
onceki_secenekler.D: Examining a much larger set of samples

revision.ne_degisti: Eski D ('cok daha buyuk bir ornek kumesi') uydurmaydi ve buluntunun tek bir bireye ait olmasiyla acikca celisiyordu; B ise dogrulanamayan bir mutlaklik ('her katman') tasiyordu. Dort secenek de artik D ve E paragraflarinda gercekten anlatilan islerden biri (X isini olcumu, katmanli yapinin olculmesi, desen ayikliyici rutin, veri tabani karsilastirmasi); hangi isin hangi yontemin oldugunu bilmek icin paragrafi okumak gerekiyor. Dogru secenek kanit cumlesinin sozcuklerinden de uzaklastirildi.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: What was the team's purpose-built image-processing method used for?
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: A custom image-processing method, developed to detect the repeating pattern typical of myelin, the fatty sheath that wraps around nerve fibres, helped distinguish genuine neural structures from random glassy debris.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Sorunun ekseni yontem adiyla islev arasindaki apacik eslesmeydi: 'goruntu isleme' denince elementleri olcmek, protein veri tabani taramak ya da katman saymak kendiliginden eleniyor, geriye 'goruntude gercek dokuyu ayirt etmek' kaliyordu. Aday pasaji hic gormeden akil yurutmeyle dogruyu buluyordu (blind_basis: logic).
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Yuva bosaltilip pasajin baska bir yerine tasindi: kasabanin ustunu ortan 20 metrelik malzemenin ne zaman biriktigi (A/3). Genel kultur burada YANLIS secenege capalanmis durumda -- A (her seyin dakikalar icinde bittigi) ve B (kul yagmuruyla gomulme, yani Pompeii anlatisi) sezgisel olan ama metnin curuttugu iki secenek. Dogru secenek yalniz A/3'un 'izleyen gunler boyunca' kaydiyla bulunuyor.

items.prompt: Which TWO of the following did the research team use in identifying the glassy material?

options.text: Sequencing DNA extracted from the remains
Radiocarbon dating of the material taken from the skull
A routine written specially to recognise one repeating pattern
A scan of the intact skull made with hospital imaging equipment
An experiment in which fresh tissue was heated to reproduce the effect
A comparison with existing records of proteins found in the brain
Measurements of the heat still held by the deposits around the building

items.evidence: A custom image-processing method, developed to detect the repeating pattern typical of myelin, the fatty sheath that wraps around nerve fibres, helped distinguish genuine neural structures from random glassy debris. Finally, comparison against reference databases of proteins expressed in the human brain provided independent confirmation of the tissue's origin.

distractor_analysis.A: Metinde yok -- eski DNA dizilemesi arkeolojik kalintilarda en cok anlatilan is oldugu icin sezgi buraya gidiyor; D paragrafinin sayilan hicbir basamagi DNA'ya degmiyor, F/2'de anilan sey protein, gen degil.
distractor_analysis.B: Metinde yok -- radyokarbon tarihleme de kalintilarla birlikte anilan tanidik bir yontem, ama pasajda hicbir tarihleme islemi gecmiyor; buluntunun yasi patlamanin tarihinden (A/1) biliniyor.
distractor_analysis.D: Metinde yok -- kafatasini bozmadan goruntuleme sezgisel bir adim gibi durur; D/2'de anilan goruntuleme taramali elektron mikroskobu, yani orneklerin cok yuksek buyutmede incelenmesi, hastane cihaziyla tarama degil.
distractor_analysis.E: Metinde yok -- camlasmayi laboratuvarda yeniden uretme fikri G/2'nin isil kosul tartismasindan cagrisim yapiyor, ama orada anlatilan sey bir deney degil bir cikarim.
distractor_analysis.G: Metinde yok -- cevredeki tortularin isisi olculmus gibi gorunebilir, cunku A/2 akintilarin sicakligini veriyor; o sayi bu calismanin olcumu degil, olayin tarifi.

items.explanation: Paragraph D says a custom image-processing method was developed to detect the repeating pattern typical of myelin, and that comparison against reference databases of brain proteins gave independent confirmation of the tissue's origin.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Which TWO findings about the structures inside the tissue does the writer report?
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Individual cell bodies ranged from 2.7 to 14.2 micrometres across, and the myelin sheaths retained their characteristic multilayered structure, complete with the regular repeating pattern seen under a microscope in ordinary, unfossilised nervous tissue.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Secenekler bicimlerinden ayirt ediliyordu: yanlislar ya mutlak ('hepsi hemen hemen ayni genislikte') ya da metnin butun tonuna ters ('olcumler herhalde yaklasikti', 'kiliflar katmanli yapisini yitirmisti') yazilmisti; pasajin butun ekseni korunmusluk oldugu icin 'olculmus ve korunmus' diyen iki secenek okumadan seciliyordu (blind_basis: logic).
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Yuva olcum bulgularindan yontem secimine tasindi (kanit D/3 + D/4) ve genel kultur bilincli olarak yanlis seceneklere capalandi: DNA dizileme, radyokarbon tarihleme ve kafatasi taramasi -- eski kalintilar denince ilk akla gelen ucu de metinde yok. Dogru ikili ise ancak D paragrafi okunarak bulunan iki alisilmadik basamak. Ayrica E/3 kanit olarak bosaltildi ve matching-information 29'a birakildi.
